# EarlyApply

> EarlyApply is a free Chrome and Edge browser extension for LinkedIn Jobs. It helps job seekers find new jobs early. It is not a job board, has no job listings of its own, and is not made by or affiliated with LinkedIn.

## What it does
- Filters LinkedIn job searches by how recently jobs were posted, such as the last 15 minutes or last hour
- Lists a search newest first on LinkedIn's new AI job search
- Job Radar checks a search every few minutes and alerts you to new jobs. It needs the LinkedIn jobs tab to stay open
- Can hide promoted, reposted, viewed and applied jobs, staffing agencies, and blocked companies or title words
- Can show only Easy Apply jobs, or hide them
- Saves your answers so you can copy them into Easy Apply forms. It never fills in or submits applications
- Free, with no account or sign-up

## Install
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mdnefacoafkpdmbnjdaijlgahjnebgbo)
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/hnjfgommfnihplmlicjdfkheokdmnnep)
